import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/moran_local_2022_no2.csv')
adjacency = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Check for missing values and impute the mean NO2 value for each borough
data['NO2_value'] = data['NO2_value'].fillna(data['NO2_value'].mean())

# Compute the neighborhood NO2 values
neighborhoods = adjacency.groupby('borough')['neighbor'].apply(lambda x: [adjacency.loc[adjacency['borough'] == i, 'NO2_value'].mean() for i in x]).reset_index()
neighborhoods = neighborhoods.rename(columns={'neighbor': 'neighborhood_value'})

# Merge the data with the neighborhood values
data = pd.merge(data, neighborhoods, on='borough')

# Identify Hot and Cold Spots
data['neighborhood_high'] = np.where(data['neighborhood_value'] > data['neighborhood_value'].mean(), 1, 0)
data['borough_high'] = np.where(data['NO2_value'] > data['NO2_value'].mean(), 1, 0)
data['hot_cold'] = np.where((data['borough_high'] == 1) & (data['neighborhood_high'] == 1), 'HH', np.where((data['borough_high'] == 0) & (data['neighborhood_high'] == 0), 'LL', 'NA'))

# Perform a permutation/randomization test
np.random.seed(0)
test_statistic = 0
significance_measure = 0
for _ in range(500):
    data_shuffled = data.copy()
    data_shuffled['NO2_value'] = np.random.permutation(data_shuffled['NO2_value'])
    data_shuffled['neighborhood_value'] = np.random.permutation(data_shuffled['neighborhood_value'])
    data_shuffled['borough_high'] = np.where(data_shuffled['NO2_value'] > data_shuffled['NO2_value'].mean(), 1, 0)
    data_shuffled['neighborhood_high'] = np.where(data_shuffled['neighborhood_value'] > data_shuffled['neighborhood_value'].mean(), 1, 0)
    data_shuffled['hot_cold'] = np.where((data_shuffled['borough_high'] == 1) & (data_shuffled['neighborhood_high'] == 1), 'HH', np.where((data_shuffled['borough_high'] == 0) & (data_shuffled['neighborhood_high'] == 0), 'LL', 'NA'))
    test_statistic += np.sum(data_shuffled['hot_cold'] == 'HH')
    significance_measure += np.sum(data_shuffled['hot_cold'] == 'LL')
test_statistic /= 500
significance_measure /= 500

# Report the identified Hot and Cold Spots
data_points_used = len(data)
print(f'data_points_used = {data_points_used}')
print(f'FINAL ANSWER: {data[data["hot_cold"] == "HH"].sort_values(by="borough")["borough"].tolist()} (HH, test statistic = {test_statistic}, significance measure = {significance_measure})')
